notes.title: Added Steam Multiplayer (with a few tweaks and fixes)
notes.content:
[p]Writing this post myself this time,
I added a way to use Steam's P2P Multiplayer in the lobby configuration in case the default setting doesn't work.

Also some tweaks:
- fixed an infinite Bastolic set interaction
- fixed pvp
- added visual popup for +1 diamonds when merging divines

The new system may cause some issues with the coop, so feel free to report any issues here in discord or add me on steam.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/842d184fc005f671ab1e9b617cc332b73b2cc98b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Megaloot Update v 1.21
notes.content: [p][b]Hello adventurers![/b][/p][p]We'd like to announce our new Regular Update (1.21), with the new QoL features, game mode changes, balance changes, and bug fixes![/p][p][/p][h1]Features[/h1][h3]Endless Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Endless Monolith[/b] now appears on Floor 56. Activating it makes the run endless, so you can go beyond Floor 100. The separate [b]Endless mode[/b] has been [b]removed[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/7ac520aea89f9ad626a2a2b2a90915a77943dd56.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]Sets Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Removed [b]Flow[/b]. notes.title: Megaloot Major Update - PvP (1.19)
notes.content:
[b]Hello adventurers![/b]
We’ve prepared a big update that introduces one more game mode - PvP! To celebrate, Megaloot will be on sale from today [b]until May 27th[/b] with a [b]50% discount[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440380/Megaloot/

[h1]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added [b]PvP mode[/b]. In this mode, you can choose your team and compete with other players to see who gets farther in the tower. The first one to die loses the match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/034083b4c57aefca816f535cfb5e30d601caf2b2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/fc620bea208a5f62260168760c18d7740b380c19.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/1bcb6fffa4a591a4edcf60b0be62c47b444cbf78.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/f5f00ee55027facaa20a1bd82287ac5e8b457cd4.png[/img]

notes.title: Megaloot Major Update 1.17
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone!
[/b]Megaloot is on sale for 40% starting today and ending on February 23rd and for that, we'd like to announce our new Major Content update, packed with new features, balance changes, and bug fixes!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440380/Megaloot/

[h1]Here’s what’s new in this update:
[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Banish Unwanted Loot[/b] - After clearing a floor, you’ll receive a few random items that can be banished! Once banished, they won’t appear in the shop again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/7e1f313f99a2563a0902b50ef037b293a983cf8a.png[/img]
[*] [b]Reforged Items[/b] - These items come with random additional stats, set boosters and passives. And the deeper you go, the stronger those stats become. You can spot them by the colorful outline at the bottom of the slot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/fa3c654a032f403ae4f1abb2c5e16805e960117f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/f68f8c4adf041ada15f22db1ad3904ee2c8e6ecd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/585ab553da719396610eae580cbd3d4f13d2c82c.png[/img]
[*] [b]Multiple Save Slots[/b] – You can now have multiple saves and switch between different adventures at any time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/8ab78036929df69526f3fed0490f48c4507e62ef.png[/img]
[*] [b]Flow Mechanic and Sets limit removal[/b] – Flow is a new system that affects both potions and sets. It is consumed when equipping a new set or using a potion. Now, you can equip as many sets as you want - as long as you have enough Flow. Different sets require different amounts of Flow. Flow spent on the potions refills after each battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/f5ddccadb5c46852a7e4495789993a6e12882e70.png[/img]
[*] [b]Stat Limits Introduced[/b] – Some stats  now have caps, like Toughness maxing out at 95%, to ensure better balance. You can always check if a stat has a cap by looking at the bottom of its description.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/e5539ad7bfe450bf785a2d7ffcf6ff2673d3ffbf.png[/img]
[*] [b]New Item[/b]: Vampiric Helmet – This update wasn’t originally planned as a content update, but I couldn’t resist adding a brand-new helmet to the Vampiric set.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/4667cfbfc3ad760c7f233e37baccd3dadb26bec5.png[/img]
[*] [b]New enemy[/b]: Uranus - You’ll encounter him starting from Floor 23.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/0ed9cd8648b6b11e0e55de67fc5c6a59d4e5e946.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/060e6eee2f034913f4ba6684d78bb22d4d93736f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/87e0576afe4459a4bef3de7f5c3caf54120e3224.png[/img]
[*] [b]New potion[/b]: Health Potion - Restores 25% Health
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/69febb5a34e471c2c11a894a6063e51c4a62c658.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]UI & UX Changes:
[/h1]
[list]
[*]The attack indicator is now located near the attack button. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/cf11b4ec33566668284a86b88202b4f419fe5ce3.png[/img]
[*] Damage and action text has been made smaller to prevent it from covering the enemy’s health.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/e7450de7dfb6ebeabab8ac0d7b414424c1d342f0.png[/img]
[*] You can now see a tip on market items that you've selected in the Build Planner.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/ad2769457ca18d9299bf0d9c2ce0495753680d90.png[/img]
[*] Added Brightness and Contrast options in the video settings
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/2c5d06f6fa7288784e541102d5fca31d1c002127.png[/img]
[*] If there are more than two players in your Co-Op game, each player will now have unique borders on their character image for better distinction
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/1a02ef850036cc56ffa51cd00c353bacfaf62636.png[/img]
[*] You can now view Steam profiles directly from the death messages.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/eaa3eb2df04012868dae5b8d7462eb085a71b736.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes:
[/h1]
[h2]Enemy Rebalancing [/h2]
Smoother progression with better-scaling enemies.
[h2]Dismantle has been removed.[/h2]
Dismantle was introduced at launch to add more interaction to the shop, but over time, it pushed the game in a direction I really didn’t like. So, I had to make the tough decision to remove it.  Megaloot is supposed to be about loot, not just stats. When players can get everything too easily, the buildcrafting aspect becomes less interesting. 
[h2]Item Rebalance [/h2]
The following changes have been made:
[list]
[*] [b]Moonflowers Extract[/b] - Changed from granting a stack of Focused to granting 3 stacks of Magic Blitz.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/71f748aaa429b20e67010f17650a9766b9e9a620.png[/img]
[*] [b]Flesh Set[/b] - Changed from granting a stack of Vimblow on healing to allowing you to heal over Max Health.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/52e9f8810de2283a59a0341109c9336a6a2cf27d.png[/img]
[*] [b]Demonic Axe[/b] - New Passive Added (Shatterwave – Deals 25% of your attack damage to enemies around after hitting your target).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/7011561a41aebc56412b7a58b7eecef8da915cd2.png[/img]
[*] [b]Magma Set[/b] - Changed from bonus Cinder Damage to granting 1 stack of Cinder Essence before the start of the turn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/387ac6b631ab4380497d900dbec1ee81c837bd80.png[/img]
[*] [b]Cinder essence[/b] - Changed from Immolating once per turn for every Cinder Essence to consuming all stacks at the beginning of the turn and Immolating for each one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/0c2968150ec0999927a0419803e4e18d8494c5ed.png[/img]
[*] [b]Common Alchemist’s Wisdom[/b] - New Passive Added (Manaflow – Sets your Max Mana to 1).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/4e33235bda2349fa3970270b75e0a06e7dfe4077.png[/img]
[/list]
[h2]Other Balance Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Enemy damage reduction[/b] now decreases by 1% each turn
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/e445a3596cbd3280f3495d6575f95f990dc46213.png[/img]
[*] All enemies on the same floor now drop the same amount of gold, with an extra gold reward for the final battle on that floor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/d2e9ec2068e0d66e70d25dc52bbf307278b41eb9.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes & Other Improvements
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed crashes and bugs on Floors above 100.
[*] Numerous co-op bugs have been fixed.
[*] General fixes and optimizations for a smoother gameplay.
[/list]

Thank you for being part of this amazing community. We’d love to hear your feedback, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts on the [url=https://discord.gg/Fq2ype9kCd]Discord[/url] server or on [url=https://x.com/playmegaloot]Twitter[/url].
🎉 Enjoy the update and see you in the Tower! 🎉
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/9a50dc264e0128b7b61cb6b292da4e90872f26cf.png[/img]

notes.title: The time for the Megaloot Prelude has come!

Hello everyone, over the past two weeks our focus of our attention was focused on the recent Playtest, throughout that period we’ve collected some wonderful statistics and today we will be sharing all that and how it went.

We are happy that most of the feedback from players matches our production and what we visioned Megaloot to be. All the things that were said in our Discord, Steam Discussions, reports, e-mail, and the feedback form will definitely benefit us. Most people have rated our game highly, and we couldn't be happier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/c3b8c7435843db3039cc187e78e35af38ea537c6.png[/img]

[h2]Let’s start our blog with some insights on the playtest![/h2]
[b][list]
[*] How many people signed up for the playtest?
[/list][/b]
We opened the playtest from April 18th — May 2nd, 2024 (two weeks) and managed to get the interest of over 3,000 players worldwide, which is something we never expected.
[b][list]
[*] How many people actually played the game and for how long?
[/list][/b]
This is interesting because we had a high percentage of people play the game they signed up for, from the 3,000 people who signed up, 67% of them actually played the game, which totalled to 2,000 players and the median playtime was 1h 40 minutes.
[list]
[*] [b]How many Wishlists has the playtest generated?[/b]
[/list]
We’ve received a little over 5,000 Wishlists that, we believe, were generated from this playtest during the period, a small number with a big impact overtime. 😉
[list]
[*] [b]How much time did people spend playing Megaloot?[/b]
[/list]
We’ve asked this question from the form and it was clear that you guys loved the game so much that 33% of all players spent 5h and more!
